SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-VD-01: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition — Logical Model: View Definition, Key Elements: Resource, ViewDefinition.resource/profile/fhirVersion. Test these items: ViewDefinition represents a tabular projection of one FHIR resource type, resource 1..1 required FHIR ResourceType binding, profile 0..* canonical profile declarations, fhirVersion 0..* FHIRVersion binding, root resource table selection and resourceType filtering, zero-or-more output rows per resource instance. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2.1.0-pre ViewDefinition.profile: 0..* canonical(StructureDefinition), each profile SHALL be based on ViewDefinition.resource; FHIR JSON repeating elements must be arrays and canonical values use the FHIR canonical primitive syntax.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe: parse_view_definition({'resource':'Patient','profile':['not a canonical with spaces'], ...}) accepted the malformed canonical. Direct ViewDefinition(resource='Patient', profile='not a list', select=[...]) generated SQL instead of rejecting the 0..* canonical-array shape.
issues.root_cause: The parser treated ViewDefinition.profile as a generic string array and SQLGenerator only validated fhirVersion for direct ViewDefinition dataclass inputs. That let canonical primitive validation and repeating-field shape checks drift between parser, serializer, and direct generation paths.
issues.resolution: Added validate_canonical_array() and reused it for root profile parsing, meta.profile validation, ViewDefinition.to_dict(), and SQLGenerator direct-input guards. Added parser and generator regression tests plus a fresh mixed-resource native/fallback probe.
